criteria.name: Runnable application and complete game flow
criteria.reason: Entry is an unmatched class-method fragment; isolated build fails Expression expected, with no Game declaration/setup.

criteria.name: Circuit, scenery and environmental presentation
criteria.reason: Track module draws a straight rectangle, start-line/barrier/tree outlines and off-road loop checkpoints; undefined length and no continuous circuit prevent functionality.

criteria.name: Differentiated selectable vehicles
criteria.reason: No complete car construction/selection startup is saved.

criteria.name: Keyboard driving and handling
criteria.reason: Player method includes acceleration, reverse, friction and speed-dependent steering/translation, but lacks runnable surrounding setup.

criteria.name: Independent interacting NPC opponents
criteria.reason: Opponent target steering and distance speed changes exist, but targetCheckpoint never advances and traffic/passing/collision/recovery are absent.

criteria.name: Vehicle, barrier and obstacle collisions
criteria.reason: Track.checkCollisions is an empty comment-only stub; no functional interaction.

criteria.name: Three usable race cameras
criteria.reason: Three position formulas are outlined, but hood orientation is fixed and the application cannot run.

criteria.name: Validated laps, timing, positions and finish
criteria.reason: Checkpoint/progress sorting/lap/results methods exist, but lap logic lacks validated directed circuit finish and timing/countdown setup is missing.

criteria.name: Menus, HUD, instructions and interface hierarchy
criteria.reason: HUD/result update methods refer to absent DOM/setup; no usable menu-to-results interface.

criteria.name: Truthful deliverables and verification evidence
criteria.reason: Failed build produced no new browser captures; no implementation report.

judgment.summary: Needs revision: the isolated build fails because main.js is a truncated class-method fragment with an unmatched closing brace. No browser gameplay starts, and the remaining saved source lacks a complete connected racing application.
